metric_notes.prompt_story_similarity: Cosine similarity between prompt and generated story (multilingual sentence model when available, otherwise TF-IDF proxy). Higher means the story stayed on-topic.
metric_notes.rougeL_prompt_vs_story: ROUGE-L F1 overlap between prompt and story; low values are normal since stories expand on prompts.
metric_notes.wer: Word Error Rate between story text and ASR transcription of narration. Lower is clearer. Computed only when TTS+ASR both ran.
metric_notes.cer: Character Error Rate, same comparison as WER but character-level.
metric_notes.tts_time_s: Mean narration synthesis latency per sample.
metric_notes.rtf: Real-time factor = synthesis_time / audio_duration. Below 1.0 means faster than real time.
